BusinessProfileConfig-Input.description:
Everything an operator configures for one business line (FR-08-04).

Mandatory (FR-08-05): name, domain, timezone, opening hours, at least one service,
at least one resource, booking rules and the assistant greeting.
BusinessProfileConfig-Input.title: BusinessProfileConfig

BusinessProfileConfig-Output.description:
Everything an operator configures for one business line (FR-08-04).

at least one resource, booking rules and the assistant greeting.
BusinessProfileConfig-Output.title: BusinessProfileConfig

EscalationRules.description: When to hand a conversation to a person (FR-06). The dashboard always flags it.

handoff_message.default: I'm sorry about this. I've passed your request to our team and someone will contact you shortly.
handoff_message.title: Handoff Message

EscalationRules.title: EscalationRules

FollowUpRules.description:
Messages sent after a conversation or booking, without anyone pressing a button
(FR-07, UC-07; ADR-0007). Every message has a default, so a profile can leave this out.

confirmation_message.default: {business}: your booking {reference} is confirmed for {service}, {when}, party of {party_size}. Call {business_phone} to change it.
confirmation_message.title: Confirmation Message

feedback_message.default: Thank you for contacting {business}. How did we do? Reply with a score from 1 to 5 and any comments.
feedback_message.title: Feedback Message

reminder_message.default: Reminder from {business}: {service}, {when}, party of {party_size} (booking {reference}). Call {business_phone} if your plans change.
reminder_message.title: Reminder Message

update_message.default: {business}: your booking {reference} has been changed. It is now {service}, {when}, party of {party_size}.
update_message.title: Update Message

FollowUpRules.title: FollowUpRules

Latency.description: Whole-turn reply time in milliseconds (FR-10-02); None until there are replies.
Latency.title: Latency

OpeningInterval.description: `closes` earlier than `opens` means the interval runs past midnight.
OpeningInterval.title: OpeningInterval

PhoneSetupOut.description: The profile's numbers and what to paste into the Twilio console for each.
PhoneSetupOut.title: PhoneSetupOut

Resource.description: A kind of bookable unit, e.g. "Deluxe room" x 10 (2 guests each) or "Dr. Ali" x 1.
Resource.title: Resource
